subject: Matemática
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas de cálculo de medida do volume de blocos retangulares, envolvendo as unidades usuais (metro cúbico, decímetro cúbico e centímetro cúbico).

components.description_pt: Demonstrar que preencher um prisma retangular reto com cubos produz medidas equivalentes de volume
components.description_en: Demonstrate that packing a right rectangular prism with cubes, multiplying the dimension lengths, and multiplying the height by the area of the base all produce equivalent measurements of volume
components.cc_component_description: Demonstrate that packing a right rectangular prism with cubes, multiplying the dimension lengths, and multiplying the height by the area of the base all produce equivalent measurements of volume

components.description_pt: Converter medidas de volume entre metros cúbicos, decímetros cúbicos e centímetros cúbicos
components.description_en: Convert volume measurements among cubic meters, cubic decimeters, and cubic centimeters
components.cc_component_description: Convert a measurement of length, mass, or volume from a larger unit to a smaller unit within the same system of measurement

components.description_pt: Determinar o volume de objetos tridimensionais compostos por cubos e prismas retos
components.description_en: Determine the volume of three-dimensional objects composed of cubes and right prisms in real-world problems
components.cc_component_description: Determine the volume of three-dimensional objects composed of cubes and right prisms in real-world problems

components.description_pt: Compor um problema que exija cálculo do volume de um prisma retangular
components.description_en: Compose a problem requiring calculation of the volume of a rectangular prism
components.cc_component_description: Demonstrate that packing a right rectangular prism with cubes, multiplying the dimension lengths, and multiplying the height by the area of the base all produce equivalent measurements of volume

cc_matches.description: Find the volume of a right rectangular prism with whole-number side lengths by packing it with unit cubes, and show that the volume is the same as would be found by multiplying the edge lengths, equivalently by multiplying the height by the area of the base. Represent threefold whole-number products as volumes, e.g., to represent the associative property of multiplication.
Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving area, volume and surface area of two- and three-dimensional objects composed of triangles, quadrilaterals, polygons, cubes, and right prisms.
Convert among different-sized standard measurement units within a given measurement system (e.g., convert 5 cm to 0.05 m), and use these conversions in solving multi-step, real world problems.

prerequisites.description_pt: Reconhecer volume como grandeza associada a sólidos geométricos e medir volumes por meio de empilhamento de cubos, utilizando, preferencialmente, objetos concretos.
Estabelecer expressões de cálculo de área de triângulos e de quadriláteros.
Associar figuras espaciais a suas planificações (prismas, pirâmides, cilindros e cones) e analisar, nomear e comparar seus atributos.

unlocks.description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas que envolvam o cálculo do volume de recipiente cujo formato é o de um bloco retangular.
